same_law.reason: All three cards state Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729, enacted by AB 325 (Stats. 2025, ch. 338). r-0001 states the whole section: both the conspiracy ban and the coercion ban. r-0002 states subdivision (a), the conspiracy ban. r-0003 states subdivision (b), the coercion ban. None of the cards gives a numeric figure.
